MandelbulbDeep zoom, computed in your browser

Fly into the Mandelbulb until single pixels are a trillionth of the original object. A 32-bit GPU cannot do that on its own: it runs out of precision near 1e-5. This page keeps one reference orbit in double-double arithmetic on the CPU and lets the GPU follow every pixel as a small offset from it.

W A S D
Move. Space rises, Shift sinks.
Mouse
Look (click the view first; drag if the pointer is not captured).
Q / E
Roll.
Wheel
Speed limit, as a share of the distance to the surface per second.
Z / X
Lower / raise the power (integer, 2 to 16).
F
Auto-fly forward. R resets. H shows this list.
